title: Identifying Causal Direction through a Cubic Hidden Mediator with Gaussian Noise
gap_reasons: The note proves the advertised empty-intersection theorem, but only for an exact scalar cubic channel with Gaussian disturbances, positive final noise, and monotone diffeomorphic mechanisms; it does not furnish an identification principle for a broader hidden-mediator family.

The sample direction result is only pointwise eventual consistency after assuming positive d_CF separation and computable dense dictionaries, with no primitive condition establishing that separation and no rate or usable calibration.

[D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.1 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
missing_followup_comparator@thm:positive-noise-irreversibility: inspect Qiao et al. 2021 before maintaining the no-prior-classification positioning.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the exact positive-noise empty-intersection result for the scalar cubic-Gaussian channel, together with population certification, pointwise separated-class consistency, and intervention-mean recovery; the math panel reported no findings. The field-tier claim collapsed because this is a narrow parametric irreversibility theorem and the statistical procedure assumes a positive characteristic-function gap. Re-raising it requires a new sigma-to-zero local asymptotic program with matching minimax bounds, primitive separation, and an implementable calibrated test, plus a direct comparison with Qiao et al. 2021.
tldr: Strictly positive Gaussian noise after a cubic hidden mediator makes the endpoint causal direction identifiable throughout the stipulated symmetric cubic-Gaussian class. The forward and coordinate-swapped law classes are disjoint because their conditional kernel likelihood ratios have incompatible \(y^{1/3}\) and signed \(|t|^{3/5}\) saddle scales. Within this class the endpoint law recovers all directional parameters and admits an exact characteristic-function membership certificate; on predeclared subclasses with positive \(d_{\mathrm{CF}}\) separation it also yields eventual direction selection and pointwise intervention-mean consistency.
gap: Nonlinear hidden mediation destroys the ordinary endpoint additive-noise residual criterion. The closest cascade result gives a necessary reverse-noise formula and a linear-Gaussian collision, while the recent BiDD theorem assumes backward nonexistence and proves consistency only when no nonlinear mediator remains. No inspected primary source classifies the positive-noise cubic intersection.
fill: Prove compact-uniform posterior concentration at the two saddle scales, deduce \(\mathcal F\cap\mathcal B=\varnothing\), recover the unique directional witness from conditional cumulants, and couple an exact law certificate to a statistically honest separated-class estimator and intervention-mean recovery result.
